channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyrone Corbin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyrone Corbin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl, Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Marc Stein:DeMarcus Cousins tells ESPN:

“I don't fire coaches or hire them. Everyone knows I liked and respected Coach Malone. I didn't want that to happen. I'm not involved in any coaching decisions. I've heard that George Karl is a great coach. If that is the direction the organization chooses, I'll support it. Out of respect for Coach Corbin, I hadn't planned on making any comments about what is out there. But at this point I felt some things needed to be clarified”

DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl, Tyrone Corbin, Feb 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @ESPNSteinLine.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl, Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Cousins said in a statement released by his agents.

“I just hope they make a decision soon and stick with it. George Karl is an experienced, proven coach and if that is who they chose to coach this team, I will support it. I do not like all these discussions in the media while we have a coach in place. It is a distraction and not fair to Coach Corbin and this team.”

DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl, Tyrone Corbin, Feb 10, 2015. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Trey Burke on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Trey Burke on Ty Corbin:

“He instilled a lot of confidence inside of me. ... He made me a better player, no doubt in my mind.”

Trey Burke on Tyrone Corbin, Feb 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Jason Jones:DeMarcus Cousins on Corbin's status:

“I didn’t know. I didn’t know officially until last night either. That’s when a lot of us found out.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Tyrone Corbin, Dec 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Pete D'Alessandro on Mark Jackson, Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
“Honestly, it was not a meeting. Ty (Corbin) is (our) coach. Mark(Jackson) is our friend. End of story,”

Pete D'Alessandro on Mark Jackson, Tyrone Corbin, Dec 17, 2014. Source: Twitter @SpearsNBAYahoo.

item.title: Jerry Sloan on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Bill Oram:Jerry Sloan on Ty Corbin:

“I didn’t think he was treated fairly by the press… I think he deserves better than that.”

Jerry Sloan on Tyrone Corbin, Jun 20, 2013. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Paul Millsap on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
“It just depends on how we come out and play and how focused we are when we get out there. A lot depends on focus, especially with a young team. Coach [Tyrone Corbin] is always telling us focus, got to keep our focus and if we do that we’ll be fine.”

Paul Millsap on Tyrone Corbin, Dec 24, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Jazz GM Dennis Lindsey on Tyrone's Corbin extension:

“We want to make sure everybody understands that Ty's the leader and he's in charge.”

Dennis Lindsey on Tyrone Corbin, Oct 30, 2012. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Jody Genessy:New Jazz GM Dennis Lindsey:

“My message to Ty (Corbin) was short and sweet: I want a relationship built upon honesty and respect.”

Dennis Lindsey on Tyrone Corbin, Aug 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Greg Miller on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
Jazz CEO Greg Miller expressed his confidence in Corbin, a former Utah player who'd been a Sloan assistant for seven seasons.

“I am confident that Tyrone is the right man to lead this team into the future,”

Greg Miller on Tyrone Corbin, Mar 3, 2011. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Greg Miller on Tyrone Corbin
item.description:
“But now that he's gone, I'm excited. I'm excited about Tyrone. Tyrone and I are contemporaries. And we are coming in under similar circumstances. He is replacing a legendary coach here in Salt Lake City and I took over for someone who was a beloved member of the community that I was compared to when he died. I still am. And that's one of the things I told Tyrone. We had dinner the other night. And I said, you should absolutely take things that you liked from Jerry. But you have to do what you think is right, too.”

Greg Miller on Tyrone Corbin, Feb 14, 2011. Source: NBA.com.
